q: According to the Red Book 2017, which is NOT an exception allowing work outside normal working hours?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The work is unavoidable or necessary for protection of life or property or safety of the Works

choices.label: B
choices.text: The Contractor wishes to recover delays he has caused

choices.label: C
choices.text: It is otherwise stated in the Contract

explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 6.5.

q: According to the Red Book 2017, whom must the Contractor appoint to be responsible for health and safety at the Site?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 6.7.

q: According to the Red Book 2017, if the Engineer does not object within how many days to a proposed Key Personnel appointment, he is deemed to have consented?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 6.12.

q: According to the Silver Book, whom must the Contractor appoint at the Site to be responsible for health and safety and protection against accidents?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Silver Book 2017, Sub-Clause 6.7.

q: According to the Silver Book, can the Contractor replace any of the Key Personnel without the Employer's consent?

choices.label: A
choices.text: No, not without the Employer's prior consent

explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Silver Book 2017, Sub-Clause 6.12.
